output.title: New ACME profile selection; ACME issuer use not visible
output.content: The release note describes a new capability: cert-manager can now select ACME certificate profiles, such as Let's Encrypt's `tlsserver` and `shortlived`. It does not describe a change to existing behaviour, and the excerpt is cut off before it says how profiles are configured. The environment shows `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests and the `certificates.cert-manager.io` CRD, but no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, and the CRD dimension is marked absent, so I can't tell whether any ACME issuer is in use. To check, look at your Issuer/ClusterIssuer resources for ACME configuration, then read the full 1.18 release note section to see whether profile selection needs any action or is only available if you want it.
